title: The Lost Dog
lines: Omar got a dollar from his gran.
He ran all the way to the shop by the barn.
The shop had a big red kite in the window.
Omar had wanted that kite for a long time.
Then a dog ran up with a red collar on.
It had no one with it and no home.
The dog was thin and its feet were black.
Omar called out, but the dog ran off.
He ran after it. That made it run more.
So he sat down and held out his hand.
He was still. He did not call at all.
The dog came back and sat by him.
Omar took it to the vet next to the shop.
The vet looked at the tag on the collar.
She made a call. Then they had to wait.
Omar sat with the dog and rubbed its back.
A tall sailor came in with wet boots.
"That is my dog!" he called out.
The dog jumped up and licked his hand.
The sailor said he had looked all day.
He gave Omar a dollar for his help.
Now Omar had two. He got the red kite.

questions.ask: What was Omar going to get with his dollar?
questions.listenFor: A big red kite in the shop window. It is near the top, before the dog turns up.

questions.ask: What did Omar try first to get the dog to come?
questions.listenFor: He called, then he ran after it, and both made the dog run off. Sitting still worked.

questions.ask: Was it fair of the sailor to give Omar a dollar? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason, not a right choice.
